an10.92:1.1: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena Bhagavā . . .pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 2.
an10.92:2.1: Yato kho gahapati ariyasāvakassa pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti, catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti, ariyo c' assa ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho, so ākaṅkhamāno attanā 'va attānaṃ vyākareyya
an10.92:2.2: ‘khīṇanirayo 'mhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpanno 'ham asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano' ti.
an10.92:3.1: Katamāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti? 3.
an10.92:3.2: Yaṃ gahapati pāṇātipātī pāṇātipātapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikam pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikam pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, cetasikam pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti; pāṇātipātā paṭivirato neva diṭṭhadhammikaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, na samparāyikaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an10.92:3.3: Pāṇātipātā paṭiviratassa evan taṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti. 4.
an10.92:4.4: surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikam pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikam pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, cetasikam pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti; surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato neva diṭṭhadhammikaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, na samparāyikaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an10.92:4.5: Surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratassa evan taṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti.
an10.92:4.6: Imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantani honti.
an10.92:5.2: Idha gahapati ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
an10.92:5.3: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an10.92:5.5: ‘svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī' ti.
an10.92:5.7: ‘supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujupaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyapaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcipaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yad idaṃ cattāri purisayugāni, aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā' ti.
an10.92:5.8: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññūppasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
an10.92:6.1: Katamo c' assa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti supaṭividdho? 6.
an10.92:6.3: Iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti, imass' uppādā idaṃ uppajjati,
an10.92:6.4: imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti, imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati. Yad idaṃ
an10.92:6.16: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
an10.92:6.17: Avijjāya tveva asesavirāganirodhā saṅkhāranirodho, saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho, nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho, saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
an10.92:6.18: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti,
an10.92:6.19: ayañ c' assa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho.
an10.92:7.1: Yato kho gahapati ariyasāvakassa imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti, imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti, ayañ c' assa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho, so ākaṅkhamāno attanā 'va attānaṃ vyākareyya
an10.92:7.2: ‘khīṇanirayo 'mhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpanno 'ham asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano'
